title: Reverse Thrusters
summary: Reverse-score negatively worded items and average a composite scale score with rowMeans().
hints: On a 1–5 scale the reversed score is `6 - x`: `mutate(m2_r = 6 - m2, m5_r = 6 - m5)`.
`cor(morale$m1, morale$m2, use = "complete.obs")` before, and the same with `m2_r` after.
`mutate(morale_score = rowMeans(pick(m1, m2_r, m3, m4, m5_r, m6), na.rm = TRUE))`, then `mean(morale$morale_score)`.
